name: Shadowfang Keep: Archmage Arugal still curses a healer
contract: Archmage Arugal 4275 is the Shadowfang Keep (map 33, expansion 0) encounter boss. His Ascension kit casts Curse
of Arugal 2102679 (charm) at a random player in event phase 1 (event 9001, first after 10.2-12.2 s, then every
25-27 s; the kit's aggro event sets phase 1). His original Arugal's Curse 7621 shares phase 1, but his evades
reset it first. On Ascension his curses still take tanks and healers, so he is exempt from the vanilla dungeon
boss control rule (BossControlTargeting.h). With only a Vanguard 21 tank and a Fleshweaver 25 healer, the healer
is the only non-top-threat player and must still be cursed. The fight is on a Shadow Port 7586 landing point
(spell_target_position), within 30 yd of his spawn and his other port points but one. The players are level 26
humans, matching the boss, so its spells land at their normal hit chance. They group in Stormwind and teleport
into one instance, where the boss is summoned at its own stats; player health fixtures keep everyone alive
